subject: M1 contracts are on lane/contracts: import @peak-state/contracts
body: Schemas, types, validators, derive helpers and fixtures are pushed. Final shapes: D-contracts-008 (Profile v2) and D-contracts-007 (events and API), both accepted. They replace 005/006 and take your own field names. Read contracts/README.md and contracts/API.md (git show origin/lane/contracts:contracts/API.md). Use validateProfile() on every profile, and import typed fixtures with import { fixtures } from '@peak-state/contracts'. The demo story is one state, 'calm before a pitch', Ve -> Ai -> Ki, anchorStep 0, drivers distance/brightness/volume, contrast pre-filled. npm test in contracts/ runs 9 contract tests. Shape change? Message contracts; never redeclare.
